const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
manifest=.ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/PACK-MANIFEST.json
base=evidence/quality/repair-window-16-20260923/orchestration
count=0
bytes=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel expected_sha expected_bytes; do
  test -f "$src"
  actual_sha=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  actual_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$src")
  test "$actual_sha" = "$expected_sha"
  test "$actual_bytes" = "$expected_bytes"
  if test -e "$base/$rel"; then
    cmp -s "$src" "$base/$rel" || { echo "DIFFERING_EXISTING_TARGET $base/$rel"; exit 42; }
  fi
  count=$((count+1))
  bytes=$((bytes+actual_bytes))
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
printf 'PACK_PREFLIGHT_OK count=%s bytes=%s\n' "$count" "$bytes"
for src in \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/ADJUDICATION-R0.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/ADJUDICATION-F1.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/ADJUDICATION-R2.json \
  .ai/task/repair-w16-20260923/ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-queue-1.log \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-queue-1-timing.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-catalog.log \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-catalog-timing.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-migration.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-migration-timing.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-migration-run.log \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-migration-run-timing.json \
  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-migration.json; do test -f "$src"; done
printf 'ATTACHMENT_AND_MIGRATION_SOURCES_OK\n'
find .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window16-20260923-candidate-catalog -type f | wc -l",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 3000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我在写入前只读核验 194 个快照源文件的 SHA/字节、现有目标冲突及所有附件来源吗？"
});
text(r.output);

root=evidence/quality/repair-window-16-20260923

count=0
bytes=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel expected_sha expected_bytes; do

  cmp -s "$src" "$dst"

  count=$((count+1))
  bytes=$((bytes+actual_bytes))

printf 'PACK_COPY_OK count=%s bytes=%s\n' "$count" "$bytes"

printf 'PACK_MANIFEST_LITERAL_COPY_OK sha256=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "$root/orchestration-pack-manifest.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
